name: spanel
description: SPanel — game/application/web hosting control panel (Panel + Daemon)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @spanel/panel && npm run build --workspace @spanel/daemon
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @spanel/panel && npm run typecheck --workspace @spanel/daemon
scripts.test: npm run test:integration --workspace @spanel/panel && npm run test --workspace @spanel/daemon
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
